name: alamin-one-dark-pro
description: A refined, eye-friendly One Dark Pro theme for VS Code and Antigravity IDE, ready for npm and editor usage.
author: Alamin

scripts.deploy-local: powershell -Command "$d = @('$HOME\.vscode\extensions\alamin-one-dark-pro', '$HOME\.antigravity\extensions\alamin-one-dark-pro', '$HOME\.antigravity-ide\extensions\alamin-one-dark-pro'); foreach ($p in $d) { if (Test-Path (Split-Path $p)) { Copy-Item -Recurse -Force 'D:\alamin-one-dark-pro\*' $p; Write-Output ('Synced to: ' + $p) } }"
